description: This file defines the 'NotFound' controller class for handling 404 error pages within the OpenCart admin interface. It loads language settings, sets page title, constructs breadcrumbs, and loads common page components for rendering the error page.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Controller\Error\NotFound
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling 404 error page display in the OpenCart admin area. It sets up the page data and renders the error view.
